content: The song "To the Window, to the Wall" was originally recorded and released by the hip-hop group Insane Clown Posse in 2002. However, the version that is most well-known and popular is the one recorded by rapper Lil Jon and his group Lil Jon & The East Side Boyz. That version was released in 2003 and became a major hit, reaching the top 10 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart.
